The '''''Nieuw Archief voor Wiskunde''''' (English translated title: ''New Archive for Mathematics'') is a quarterly Dutch [[peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] of [[mathematics]] published by the [[Koninklijk Wiskundig Genootschap]] (Royal Mathematical Society) since 1875. The new version, the fifth series, started in 2000. The journal covers developments in mathematics in general and in Dutch mathematics in particular.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.nieuwarchief.nl/ |title=Nieuw Archief voor Wiskunde |last= |first= |date= |website=nieuwarchief.nl |publisher=Koninklijk Wiskundig Genootschap (official website) |access-date=9 October 2022 |language=Dutch}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://zbmath.org/serials/?q=se:00002751 |title=Nieuw Archief voor Wiskunde. Vijfde Serie |date=2022 |website=zbmath.org |publisher=[[zbMATH Open]] |access-date=9 October 2022}}</ref> It is abstracted and indexed in [[zbMATH Open]].<ref name=MATH>{{cite web |url=http://www.zentralblatt-math.org/serials/ |title=Serials Database |publisher=[[Springer Science+Business Media]] |work=[[ZbMATH Open]] |access-date=2022-10-09}}</ref>
==History==

The previous version, with the full title ''Nieuw Archief voor Wiskunde uitgegeven door het Wiskundig Genootschap'' had four series between 1875 up to 1999: Eerste reeks (First Series, 1875-1893, 20 volumes),<ref>{{cite web |url=https://zbmath.org/serials/?q=se%3A8128 |title=Nieuw Archief voor Wiskunde |date=2022 |website=zbmath.org |publisher=zbMATH Open |access-date=9 October 2022}}</ref> Tweede reeks (Second series, 1895-1949, 23 volumes),<ref>{{cite web |url=https://zbmath.org/serials/?q=se%3A3568 |title=Nieuw Archief voor Wiskunde. Tweede Serie |date=2022 |website=zbmath.org |publisher=zbMATH Open |access-date=9 October 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://sites.mathdoc.fr/cgi-bin/rbsm?idrevue=125 |title=MathDoc Gallica-Math: Répertoire Bibliographique des Sciences Mathématiques (1894-1912) Nieuw Archief voor wiskunde uitgegeven door bet Wiskundig Genootschap. Amsterdam |website=sites.mathdoc.fr |publisher=Mathdoc. Unité d'Appui et de Recherche 5638 (CNRS/UGA), Grenoble |access-date=9 October 2022}}</ref> Derde reeks (Third series, 1953-1982, 30 volumes),<ref>{{cite web |url=https://zbmath.org/serials/?q=se%3A1613 |title=Nieuw Archief voor Wiskunde. Derde Serie |date=2022 |website=zbmath.org |publisher=zbMATH Open |access-date=9 October 2022}}</ref> and Vierde reeks (Fourth series, 1983-1999, 17 volumes).<ref>{{cite web |url=https://zbmath.org/serials/?q=se%3A1704 |title=Nieuw Archief voor Wiskunde. Vierde Serie |date=2022 |website=zbmath.org |publisher=zbMA |access-date=9 October 2022}}</ref> Initially, the publishing company was Weytingh & Brave in Amsterdam.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://search.worldcat.org/title/Nieuw-archief-voor-wiskunde/oclc/1760346|title=Nieuw archief voor wiskunde|work=WorldCat|access-date=2024-05-23}}</ref>

==Predecessor journal==
In the years 1856-1874, the Wiskundig Genootschap (Mathematical Society) published three volumes of ''Archief, uitgegeven door het Wiskundig Genootschap'' with Weytingh & Brave in Amsterdam.
